let Retry = system(
  var tries in 0..2
  var req in bool
  var applied in 0..2
  var reply in {none, flying, got}
  init tries = 0 ∧ req = false ∧ applied = 0 ∧ reply = none
  action send when tries < 2 ∧ req = false ∧ reply ≠ got do tries := tries + 1, req := true
  action lose when req = true do req := false
  action deliver when req = true do req := false, applied := applied + 1, reply := flying
  action loseReply when reply = flying do reply := none
  action gotReply when reply = flying do reply := got
)
column3: = system({tries, req, applied, reply}, {send, lose, deliver, loseReply, gotReply})   [17 reachable states]
